mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointment (appointment_no, visitor_id, host_user_id, visit_reason, visit_start_time, visit_end_time, status, visitor_count, remark, batch_import_id, created_by) VALUES (#{appointmentNo}, #{visitorId}, #{hostUserId}, #{visitReason}, #{visitStartTime}, #{visitEndTime}, #{status}, #{visitorCount}, #{remark}, #{batchImportId}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM appointment WHERE status = 'APPROVED' AND visit_end_time < #{now}
SELECT * FROM appointment WHERE status = 'CHECKED_IN' AND visit_end_time < #{deadline}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{todayStart} AND #{todayEnd}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL'
